clips.title: The story
paras: At Lakeshire's bridge, Marshal Marris directs a thin guard against the Blackrock advance. With Stormwind's army absent, he turns to visiting fighters to slow the orcs in the Redridge Mountains.

Lakeshire faces gnolls to the west and the Blackrock clan to the east. Marshal Marris commands the guard line at the town's main bridge, but his supplies are low and his soldiers are stretched thin. Stormwind has sent no royal reinforcements, leaving Marris to keep the town from being overrun.

Marshal Marris knows defense alone cannot save Redridge, so he orders strikes on the orc camps. He sends fighters against Blackrock warriors and shadowcasters, then after Tharil'zun, the commander holding Stonewatch Keep's ruins. Marris aims to break the orcs' command before they can overwhelm Lakeshire.
